title: silene aprica subsp. oldhamiana
intro: Silene aprica subsp. oldhamiana, commonly known as Dunaliella, is a plant species that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. It is a type of flowering plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant is known to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which can help alleviate conditions like arthritis, skin issues, and autoimmune diseases. The bioactive constituents of Dunaliella include carotenoids, flavonoids, and other phytochemicals that contribute to its medicinal properties.
